So what will be happend to me before and after death and What I should do. Please advise me. 1520 views Q. As Salaamu Alaikum. I had a dream and would like to have it interpreted Insha Allah. I was in a house with about 5 other people both male and female, I don't think any were Muslim except for me. Something broke and 2 went to the basement to fix it, while down there, the house exploded and everyone died. In my dream we were re-created and taken back to the time before the explosion without clear memory of what was to happen. We were reading a book with stories and it became clear to me that the book was reminding me what was going to happen. I knew it was the Will of Allah SWT so I didn't fight it or try to convince other people. Instead, when I recognised the time approaching for the explosion I rushed to make wudhu & make salah as I wanted to die in a state of salah. At the time of the explosion, nothing happened. I finished my prayer and went to see the other people. One man who had gone downstairs to fix the problem(as in the beginning) smiled at me and showed me his hand which was burnt. Can you please tell me what this means? May Allah SWT reward you for your time and effort. 1610 views Q. Does these two dream are inter-related? Your guidance is highly appreciated. Question: salam! I did Istekhara to marry a man who's shia but is ready to convert to sunni.I dreamed nice flames and bright red colour.After this i woke up n again when i went to sleep i had another dream in which i saw a man lying on something which looked like parallel electric cables in sky n some birds were around him maybe prodding at him.Also i think as if i was seeing it in a photo in a newspaper(about 2nd dream).What does the first dream interpret? Does these two dream are inter-related? Your guidance is highly appreciated. Jazakallah Answer ID: 5745 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1578/1197=H/1429) The meaning of your dream is that you should never try to marry that person. You must not rely upon him though he makes definite promises of abandoning Shiaism and converting to Sunni. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
